defmodule SessionStore do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @table :session_store_ets
  @max_age_seconds 3600
  @cleanup_interval 60_000

  # Public API
  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def create_session(user_id, metadata \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:create, user_id, metadata})
  end

  def verify_session(session_id) do
    # Route through GenServer to ensure serialized access with revocation
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:verify, session_id})
  end

  def revoke_session(session_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:revoke, session_id})
  end

  def revoke_all_user_sessions(user_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:revoke_all, user_id})
  end

  # GenServer callbacks
  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    table = :ets.new(@table, [
      :named_table,
      :set,
      :protected,  # Only owning process can write
      read_concurrency: true
    ])
    schedule_cleanup()
    secret = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
    {:ok, %{table: table, secret: secret}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:create, user_id, metadata}, _from, state) do
    session_id = generate_session_id()
    created_at = System.system_time(:second)
    mac = compute_mac(session_id, user_id, created_at, state.secret)

    session_data = %{
      user_id: user_id,
      metadata: metadata,
      created_at: created_at,
      revoked: false,
      mac: mac
    }

    :ets.insert(@table, {session_id, session_data})
    {:reply, {:ok, session_id}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:verify, session_id}, _from, state) do
    result = case :ets.lookup(@table, session_id) do
      [{^session_id, session_data}] ->
        cond do
          session_data.revoked ->
            {:error, :revoked}
          session_expired?(session_data) ->
            {:error, :expired}
          true ->
            expected_mac = compute_mac(session_id, session_data.user_id, session_data.created_at, state.secret)
            if :crypto.hash_equals(expected_mac, session_data.mac) do
              {:ok, %{user_id: session_data.user_id, metadata: session_data.metadata}}
            else
              {:error, :integrity_failure}
            end
        end
      [] ->
        {:error, :not_found}
    end
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:revoke, session_id}, _from, state) do
    case :ets.lookup(@table, session_id) do
      [{^session_id, session_data}] ->
        updated = %{session_data | revoked: true}
        :ets.insert(@table, {session_id, updated})
        {:reply, :ok, state}
      [] ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:revoke_all, user_id}, _from, state) do
    match_spec = [{{
      :_, %{user_id: user_id, metadata: :_, created_at: :_, revoked: :_, mac: :_}
    }, [], [:"$_"]}]

    sessions = :ets.select(@table, match_spec)

    Enum.each(sessions, fn {sid, session_data} ->
      updated = %{session_data | revoked: true}
      :ets.insert(@table, {sid, updated})
    end)

    {:reply, {:ok, length(sessions)}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:cleanup, state) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    match_spec = [{{
      :_, %{created_at: :"$1", user_id: :_, metadata: :_, revoked: :_, mac: :_}
    }, [{:<, :"$1", now - @max_age_seconds - 300}], [true]}]

    :ets.select_delete(@table, match_spec)
    schedule_cleanup()
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  # Private helpers
  defp generate_session_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end

  defp compute_mac(session_id, user_id, created_at, secret) do
    data = <<session_id::binary, user_id::binary, created_at::64>>
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, secret, data)
  end

  defp session_expired?(%{created_at: created_at}) do
    System.system_time(:second) - created_at > @max_age_seconds
  end

  defp schedule_cleanup do
    Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup, @cleanup_interval)
  end
end

defmodule SessionController do
  @moduledoc """
  HTTP handler for session-based authentication.
  Uses SessionStore for session management with
  immediate revocation support for security incidents.
  """

  def authenticate(conn) do
    with {:ok, session_id} <- extract_session_id(conn),
         {:ok, session} <- SessionStore.verify_session(session_id) do
      {:ok, session}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def logout(conn) do
    with {:ok, session_id} <- extract_session_id(conn) do
      SessionStore.revoke_session(session_id)
    end
  end

  def emergency_revoke_user(user_id) do
    SessionStore.revoke_all_user_sessions(user_id)
  end

  defp extract_session_id(conn) do
    case Map.get(conn.cookies, "session_id") do
      nil -> {:error, :no_session}
      id when is_binary(id) and byte_size(id) == 43 -> {:ok, id}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_session}
    end
  end
end
